summary: Created a 2.05 GiB LVM logical volume (datavg/datalv) backed by two loopback devices (no spare block device existed on node1), formatted ext4, mounted at /srv/data, grew it online from an initial 1000M to 2100M (>=2GB) while mounted with data intact, made it persistent across reboot via a systemd oneshot service (lvm-backing-loop.service) that reattaches the loop devices before LVM/mount activation plus an /etc/fstab entry, and completed the mandatory single-node restart/recovery verification with a changed boot_id and confirmed post-reboot mount, LV size, and checksummed data integrity.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 disk layout: single root disk, no spare block device
pvcreate/vgcreate/lvcreate to build datavg/datalv (1000M), mkfs.ext4, mounted at /srv/data
Created systemd unit lvm-backing-loop.service to reattach loop0 at boot before LVM activation; enabled it
Added /etc/fstab entry for /srv/data by UUID with nofail and dependency on the loop service
Wrote test file + sha256 checksum into /srv/data as baseline data
Created second backing file disk2.img (1200M), attached as /dev/loop1, pvcreate + vgextend datavg
lvextend datavg/datalv to 2100M (2.05 GiB) online, resize2fs online while mounted
Verified filesystem grew to 2.1G, mount stayed active, checksum still OK
Updated lvm-backing-loop.service to attach both loop0 and loop1 at boot
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id, mount state, vgs/lvs/pvs, data content
Issued sudo systemctl reboot on node1; connection dropped confirming acknowledgement
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again
Verified boot_id changed, confirming actual restart
Verified post-reboot: /srv/data auto-mounted, LV at 2.05g, loop devices reattached, test file present and checksum verified OK

evidence.summary: pvcreate/vgcreate/lvcreate/mkfs/mount sequence succeeded; df shows /dev/mapper/datavg-datalv mounted at /srv/data
Wrote testfile.txt and sha256 checksum, confirmed initial LV size 1000.00m

evidence.requirement: VG extended with second PV to provide capacity for >=2GB
evidence.summary: Added /dev/loop1 as second PV, vgextend succeeded, VG size 2.34g

evidence.requirement: LV grown to >=2GB while mounted, contents intact
evidence.summary: lvextend to 2.05 GiB and online resize2fs while /srv/data remained mounted; df shows 2.1G; testfile content and sha256sum -c both verified OK

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline (boot identity, LVM state, data)
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 2f708738-..., mount state, vgs/lvs/pvs output, and test file contents before reboot
systemctl reboot issued; SSH connection dropped immediately confirming the reboot command was accepted

evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proving actual restart
evidence.summary: Node briefly refused connections during reboot, then returned with a new boot_id 14291e88-... differing from the pre-restart 2f708738-...

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery: LV auto-activated, filesystem auto-mounted at 2.05GiB, data intact
evidence.summary: After reboot, both loop devices reattached automatically, datavg/datalv activated at 2.05g, /srv/data auto-mounted via fstab, testfile.txt present and sha256sum -c reported OK
